entities.name: 2,4-Difluoro-5-nitrobenzoic acid
observations: Principal substrate identified as a difluoro-nitrobenzoic acid; represented as O=C(O)c1cc(F)c([N+](=O)[O-])cc1F.
Undergoes aryl fluoride substitution with ethanol under cesium carbonate conditions.

entities.name: 2-Fluoro-5-ethoxy-4-nitrobenzoic acid
observations: Probable major product from Ar-F to Ar-OEt substitution; reported SMILES CCOc1cc(C(=O)O)c(F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-].
Product retains the carboxylic acid and one aryl fluoride; no stereocenter is generated.

entities.name: SNAr of difluoronitrobenzoic acid
observations: Base-promoted nucleophilic aromatic substitution: ethanol is converted to ethoxide by cesium carbonate and displaces the activated aryl fluoride adjacent to the nitro group.
The other aryl fluoride remains unchanged.

entities.name: Ethanol-Cs2CO3 SNAr
observations: Ethanol serves as the nucleophile/ethoxy source; cesium carbonate provides basic conditions. DMF, water, and chloride-containing components may be solvent/workup auxiliaries.
